usedFor: Brix manages your signage screens, and Asana tracks the work. When “New Screen” appears in Brix, “Create Project” in Asana can open a rollout project for it.

bestTemplate.name: “New Screen” in Brix, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A new screen means setup work: install, content, check. “Create Project” sets the name, notes, dates and owner, and “New Screen” can be limited to one location.

watchOut: “New Screen” is polling, so the Asana project is created after the next check. “Create Project” makes a project on every run, so narrow the trigger to a location if you only track some sites.
